name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2026-02-03, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
